# positronick — agent manual

`positronick` is the command-line client for positronick.com. It discovers agent capabilities: souls (installable SOUL.md personality files), a registry of official tooling (harnesses, CLIs, MCP servers, agents, skills, plugins, loops), and a `research` feed of what's new (articles, releases, links) so agents avoid stale knowledge. It is built to be driven by coding agents — pass `--json` to any command for stable machine-readable JSON on stdout, read progress and errors from stderr, and branch on the exit code. Read commands never prompt. Hidden admin commands (create/update for souls and listings, create/list for profiles, and list/create/update/sync for blog feed sources) exist and appear in help and in these docs after logging in with an admin account.

Exit codes:

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | error |
| 2 | cancelled |
| 3 | not found |
| 4 | auth required |

On failure with `--json`, stderr carries exactly one error-envelope line:

```json
{"error":{"code":"<code>","message":"<message>","hint":"<optional hint>"}}
```

Error codes: `error`, `cancelled`, `not_found`, `auth_required`. `hint` is omitted when empty.

## positronick

Usage: `positronick [flags]`

Discover and install agent capabilities from positronick.com

Flags:

- `--base-url` (default ``): override the positronick.com API base URL
- `--json` (default `false`): emit machine-readable JSON on stdout
- `--no-color` (default `false`): disable color output
- `--quiet` (default `false`): suppress progress output on stderr
- `--yes` (default `false`): assume yes for confirmation prompts

## positronick agent

Usage: `positronick agent [flags]`

Discover agent SDKs and frameworks in the registry

## positronick agent install

Usage: `positronick agent install <slug> [flags]`

Print (or run with --run) the official install command for one agent

Flags:

- `--run` (default `false`): execute the install command via `sh -c` instead of printing it

## positronick agent list

Usage: `positronick agent list [flags]`

List all agent listings

Flags:

- `--category` (default ``): only results in this category (case-insensitive)
- `--limit` (default `20`): maximum number of results
- `--sort` (default `name`): sort order: relevance, name, downloads or newest

## positronick agent search

Usage: `positronick agent search <query> [flags]`

Search agent listings by fuzzy relevance

Flags:

- `--category` (default ``): only results in this category (case-insensitive)
- `--limit` (default `20`): maximum number of results
- `--sort` (default `relevance`): sort order: relevance, name, downloads or newest

## positronick agent show

Usage: `positronick agent show <slug> [flags]`

Show one agent listing in full

## positronick agent-docs

Usage: `positronick agent-docs [flags]`

Print the agent-facing manual for this CLI

## positronick auth

Usage: `positronick auth [flags]`

Inspect authentication and manage API keys

## positronick auth status

Usage: `positronick auth status [flags]`

Show who you are authenticated as (live check)

## positronick auth token

Usage: `positronick auth token [flags]`

Manage API keys for unattended use

## positronick auth token create

Usage: `positronick auth token create [flags]`

Create an API key (shown exactly once)

Flags:

- `--expires-days` (default `0`): key lifetime in days, 1-365 (0 = server default, 90)
- `--name` (default `positronick-cli`): name for the new key

## positronick init

Usage: `positronick init [flags]`

Set up this machine: detect the harness, install a soul, suggest tooling

Flags:

- `--soul` (default ``): slug of the soul to install (required when non-interactive)
- `--target` (default ``): install target: hermes, claude, cursor or openclaw (default: detected harness, else hermes)

## positronick login

Usage: `positronick login [flags]`

Log in to positronick.com via the device flow

Flags:

- `--no-browser` (default `false`): never auto-open the verification page in a browser

## positronick logout

Usage: `positronick logout [flags]`

Log out — delete the cached credentials

## positronick research

Usage: `positronick research [query] [flags]`

List what's new on positronick.com (articles, releases, links)

Flags:

- `--category` (default ``): only posts in this category
- `--kind` (default ``): only this post kind: article, release or link
- `--limit` (default `20`): maximum number of results (1–100)
- `--since` (default ``): only posts published after this ISO-8601 instant (poll the delta)
- `--tag` (default ``): only posts carrying this tag

## positronick self

Usage: `positronick self [flags]`

Manage this positronick installation

## positronick self update

Usage: `positronick self update [flags]`

Update the positronick binary to the latest release

Flags:

- `--check` (default `false`): only report whether an update is available
- `--version` (default ``): update to this release tag (e.g. v0.2.0) instead of latest

## positronick soul

Usage: `positronick soul [flags]`

Discover SOUL.md personality files

## positronick soul install

Usage: `positronick soul install <slug> [flags]`

Install a soul's SOUL.md for your agent framework

Flags:

- `--force` (default `false`): overwrite an existing file without asking
- `--link` (default `false`): claude target only: add an @-import line to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
- `--path` (default ``): write the SOUL.md to this exact file instead of the target's path
- `--target` (default ``): install target: hermes, claude, cursor or openclaw (default: detected harness, else hermes)

## positronick soul list

Usage: `positronick soul list [flags]`

List all souls

Flags:

- `--category` (default ``): only results in this category (case-insensitive)
- `--framework` (default ``): only souls supporting this framework (case-insensitive)
- `--limit` (default `20`): maximum number of results
- `--sort` (default `name`): sort order: relevance, name, downloads or newest

## positronick soul search

Usage: `positronick soul search <query> [flags]`

Search souls by fuzzy relevance

Flags:

- `--category` (default ``): only results in this category (case-insensitive)
- `--framework` (default ``): only souls supporting this framework (case-insensitive)
- `--limit` (default `20`): maximum number of results
- `--sort` (default `relevance`): sort order: relevance, name, downloads or newest

## positronick soul show

Usage: `positronick soul show <slug> [flags]`

Show one soul in full

Flags:

- `--raw` (default `false`): print only the SOUL.md body verbatim (overrides --json)

## positronick version

Usage: `positronick version [flags]`

Print the positronick CLI version
